grading_policy: Each answer judged independently on every part actually requested by its question. Correct requires all requested parts and no material contradiction; partial means required omission/unresolved part; incorrect means material contradiction. Support/evidence labels do not substitute for answer content. No facts borrowed across answers. Extra answer-key facts not actually requested are not mandatory.
